decision.scope: This review measures g29-leftover-join.v7 as a CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED leftover-design remasurement that binds NOTHING. It does not SATISFY DR-117 or DR-G29, does not make G29 QUALIFIED, records no recording act, and proposes no register row. The fold of OBL-G29-FX-AUTHORING to leftoverDesign false is warranted by bytes I recomputed: g29-fixture-corpus.v1 (D-318) authors ten implementations covering the eight g29-input-corpus.v1 initial states and the two occupancy v3 not-that-gate retained-evidence members, and g29-fixture-corpus.v2 (D-342) authors forty per-D-002-platform copies of them on the four platforms quoted from G10 occupancy v2 and ORDERED-EQUAL against G23 occupancy v2, with Windows deferred and no Windows copies on disk. g29-fixture-corpus.v2 expressly reserved that measurement for a leftover-join successor to leftover-join.v6 of G29 and did not make it itself. All forty-one cited digests, all eight cited commits, the last heading, live HEAD, the file 08 token, required-now 28 and the gate owner hold against live bytes. Frozen leftover-join.v6 of G29 remains the D-320 current recorded G29 leftover remasurement until a recordable successor is adopted; frozen leftover-join.v5 of G29 stays unrecorded; frozen leftover-join.v4 of G29 stays historical after D-320. Sixteen of sixteen attacks are refuted. Three observations travel as honesty work and none is a finding.
